# `network/syncManager/SyncManager.js`

> **Source:** `engine/network/syncManager/SyncManager.js`

network/syncManager/SyncManager.js — per-profile sync rules (network plan §20). This module only decides WHAT should sync WHERE (rules + gating); it does not move any bytes — actual transport goes through the routes/ group crypto layers built in earlier phases. Rules are local, in-memory config; callers persist them via their own storage.

## Functions

### `createSyncManager({ rules = {} } = {})`

Create a sync manager with sensible defaults (network plan §20 examples: "sync AI memory only to my devices", "never sync private keys" — private keys simply have no category here at all, by design).

**Parameters:**

- `[c]` *(object)* — _No description in source JSDoc._
- `[c.rules]` *(object)* — partial overrides keyed by category

### `setSyncRule(manager, category, { scope, enabled, targetDeviceIds } = {})`

Set/update a category's sync rule.

**Parameters:**

- `manager` *(object)* — _No description in source JSDoc._
- `category` *(string)* — one of SYNC_CATEGORIES
- `c` *(object)* — _No description in source JSDoc._
- `[c.scope]` *(string)* — one of SYNC_SCOPE
- `[c.enabled]` *(boolean)* — _No description in source JSDoc._
- `[c.targetDeviceIds]` *(string[])* — required/used when scope === SELECTED_DEVICES

**Returns:** the resulting rule

### `getSyncRule(manager, category)`

Get a category's current rule, or null if unset.

### `listSyncRules(manager)`

All rules as a flat array of `{ category, scope, enabled, ... }`.

### `shouldSync(manager, category, targetScope)`

Should `category` currently sync to `targetScope` right now? Used as a gate before a caller pushes an update over a route/group.
